column28: Keep only distcd 2nd digit = 2 or 3.  Define firms as quarterly, semi-annual, or annual payers based on payment history.  Define a consistent payer as a firm that paid quarterly or semi-annual dividends for the past 18 months, or annual dividends for the past 2 years.  An omission is the first month where a consistent payer failed to pay a dividend over the past quarter/6-months/year.  Finally, DivOmit = 1 if there is an omission in the past 2 months and 0 otherwise
